notes.title: HAVOK PHYSICS & MORE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963255/2fd5e66d08e73b22dafd51c8f0c0248f57532691.jpg[/img]

sssssssup Sup!

hope everyone had an amazing halloween, mine was suhweeeet! no pun intended lmaoaoOooOOo

Anyways...

back to business... Here's some updates:

Since the game has made money, i've invested it all back into the game whether it be in assets, advertising or whatever might be benificial for the game. For the nerds - I'm testing Unity Pro, this includes access to many things that include...

Havok Physics
https://www.havok.com/havok-physics/ - I've implemented Havok into the game which should help out in the application handling all the different game objects and enemies running around in the scene. Most noticeable when punching and attacking enemies with physical items & build up of a bunch of them attacking you.

Console Support
PSVR - Yep, having Unity Pro means that i can export playstation and console files. 
Nintendo & Xbox - Those would be getting the keyboard & mouse versions with controller settings.

& more things i've yet to dive into...

ShadowPC

https://shadow.tech/en-CA/pro

I've invested ~75/month into a a CloudPC so be able to not just handle the optics of this project but all the other ones i've been juggling. This means faster work flow and better products for all of you. Here's those specs

NVIDIA® RTX 3070 Ti / A4500

28GB RAM

AMD EPYC™ 7543P (up to 3.7 GHz) 8 vCores

C:\ 1TB SSD

D:\ Up to 5TB HDD available as an option

Windows 10 Home/Enterprise*

1Gb/s down Bandwidth

Saving & Loading

I have the code and buttons implemented in the game but for some reason they arent working, still have to do some troubleshooting.

Cloth, fluid, rope

i've invested into a new physics package that gives realistic physics for fluids, ropes, and cloth. Hoping to make Dex's leather jacket movable with the player movement. I wanted to put bottles with fluid in it like half life alyx, its just a matter of optimizing those. Because they are objects that independently require a bit of processing information by the GPU / CPU, i must learn the optimal amount to put for each scene to balance frame rate.

New Blood System

I've invested into a new realistic blood system that looks beautiful. It's a blood system when the player impacts enemies. It works with clicking but not with VR, so... Currently engineering it to work on game object impacts rather than pointer clicks... is an interesting thing...

New MDRNgames Business registration & Website

Ah, last but not least, i've invested into an overall MDRN games website for all my projects( https://mdrngames.com/) If youre in here youll get exclusive discounts to all my other experiences (Discord https://discord.gg/jdN5WXG85K). Just a cool little placeholder n stuff.

Theres more but right now thats pretty much what i can think of off the top of my head...

Happy November

from the depths,

Nathan

notes.title: Soundtrack, FPS Update, New Visuals
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963255/3b184af7e7524c3aa6d6c6e09ea5b7c850cde575.png[/img]

October 22nd 2024 - I've been listening to all the feedback and fixing as much as I can / as fast as I can.

So Here's a little update of whats going on

[b]Keyboard and mouse[/b]

Right now keyboard and mouse is just a long demo. Experience what people get to experience in virtual reality... on keyboard and mouse. The first few levels have weapons, enemies, and clues hidden around the maps. You'll have to find your way through the levels like a maze / backrooms experience.

[b]Virtual Reality[/b]

There's been a lot of little things added to make the player have a smoother time. Here's some of them

- Added 96000 bit rate WAV audio files in game so player can have the highest quality audio horror experience
- Added optimized reverb zones so player can feel as immersed as possible
- More Audio cues that will signal the player where to go
- Better A.I. Detection
- more weapons scattered around the map
- melee weapons scattered around the map
- Added more lights so the game isn't as dark
- Simplified and improved functionality of the u.i. menu when you press the secondary button on the left controller
- Added more voice overs to give the game more context / story
- Added a layer of fog, dust, and leaves.
- Added more creepy features / effects
- Fixed movement and grabbable sticks / items in "Hockey Mini-Sticks VR", everything should be function like the standalone game exclusively to Meta Quest
- Increased boss enemies health.
- Increased FPS through GPU Instanced Draws from Unity 6
- Smoothed out the swing of the crow bar
- Added blood gushes when you stab enemies with swords

Working on:
Saving Functionality
long loading screens that make it looks like the game is broken
Offline & Online Escape Room bugs
Bosses not doing damage to the player glitch
Continue to improve audio quality

notes.title: OCT 13 PATCH UPDATE
notes.notes:
[b]New updates on steam and quest[/b]

- new day house puzzle fix / update
- bosses fix now actually detect character 
- added bosses, hid weapons and a bunch of swords from Invictus around the first town
- fixed problem where witches weren’t detecting enemies or moving on nav mesh
- fixed movement and detection of mini demon children that chompy the dog boss summons
- added more environmental sounds adding depth to the game
- added GPUinstanced drawing to help back end processing on quest headsets to increase the frame rate. 
- increased resolution, because I’ve used instanced drawing I can now raise the resolution to take advantage of the freed up memory (from 0.34 to 0.7)
- fixed escape rooms glitch where 2 giant flashlights were breaking the scene 
- added more enemies to first escape room and increased their health
- added death and damage sound effects(enemies will make a gush sound when they die)
- added more voice overs to make the player feel less lost(more still need to be added)
- slight reduced the dirtiness filter on the camera to increase clarity and be able to see these graphics
